research_question: Can obvious and objectively adequate replies safely falsify a candidate before Human Policy?
conclusion: Narrow conjunction passes five selected fixed fixtures; production false-negative safety remains unestablished.
decision_target: Production automatic tactical rejection; not permission for candidate search
confirmed_facts: Three existing bishop-loss diagnostics reject, including mandatory 3a3b
Two bishop-exchange controls are not falsified
Bad recaptures are not accepted merely because they capture
No changes to Human Policy, independent270, P_good, ranking or seed universe
unknowns: Independent false-negative rate on poisoned pieces and valid sacrifices
Human obviousness of the proposed strong-witness heuristic
General validity of provisional 100cp gap and 300cp defender-advantage thresholds

important_numbers.sensitivity_meaning: All five fixture outcomes unchanged; not independent validation

cases.contents: Five full SFEN/history cases, separate surprise decision and policy reliability, obvious replies, typed scores, PVs, evidence, purpose and human review point

mandatory_3a3b.decision_reason: Unrecapturable bishop capture retains overwhelming defender advantage and is within 10cp of best explicit reply
mandatory_3a3b.human_policy_reliability: Previously low here; not used or re-evaluated
mandatory_3a3b.human_review_point: Verify 8h2b+ wins the bishop without immediate recapture

human_policy_role.falsified: No need to estimate probability of an already-obvious tactical refutation
human_policy_role.not_falsified: Not an actual candidate approval. Later policy work may assess competing natural replies only with adequate support/calibration; existing independent-validation NO remains
human_policy_role.unknown_evidence: needs_verification, never automatic pass to promotion

human_report.lead: 3 clear diagnostics rejected, 2 exchange controls retained; automatic production rejection remains INCONCLUSIVE
human_report.emphasize: Comparable reply gap is 10cp, not mixed-root 127cp; natural recaptures can lose 1931/2328cp
human_report.review: Review the mandatory bishop loss and both exchange controls, especially alternative recaptures and compensation
human_report.next_stage: Human review first; no production rejection and no next research in this cycle
